proofBoundary: Machine-verified experimental options; runtime, player-surface, semantic, save/load, and support proof remain separate.

options.name: Sirenroot
options.description: Lays the haunting Ayleid spirit to rest: Arkay, Meridia, Stendarr, Tu'whacca, Azura, Y'ffre, plus the elven pantheon (Auri-El, Xarxes, Magnus) for the Ayleid dead, and Zenithar for honest salvage work.

options.name: The Rot Below
options.description: Namira is named in the quest itself. Foiling her plan angers her and pleases the death-and-light gods; killing or sparing the freed lich Adabelle splits Mara and Dibella.

options.name: The Frozen Heart
options.description: The cursed woman is a Snow Elf, so Auri-El reacts most of all: curing her is a milestone in his eyes, killing her a grave offence. Mara, Stendarr, Trinimac and Molag Bal also weigh in.

options.name: Depths of the Soul
options.description: Zenithar approves of helping the merchant Pike open his shop.

options.name: Baba Yaga and the Labyrinth
options.description: Mara approves of rescuing the witch from the Black Stone Labyrinth.

options.name: Bark and Bite
options.description: Freeing the three werewolf spirits pleases Hircine; sparing Frija instead pleases Stendarr and disappoints him. Sheogorath is amused either way.

options.name: Before the End
options.description: Mara and Arkay approve of staying with the condemned man Aradell until the end.

options.name: War's Folly
options.description: Adds Devotion reactions to all six stances you can take with Sandor the preacher, from pride in slaughter to renouncing the war. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin (also repairs two dialogue endings that never set their quest stage).

options.name: Once We Were Here
options.description: Hoping the Falmer may yet be redeemed pleases Auri-El, their forebears' god; calling the damage irreparable disappoints him. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin.
options.dependency: Once We Were Here - Quest Mod.esp

options.name: Whispers of the Depths
options.description: Mara approves of offering condolences to the old sailor. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin.

options.name: Wyrmstooth (T13 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channel for defeating Vulthurkrah while defending Stonehollow. Machine-verified; runtime evidence remains open.

options.name: Taste of Death Addon (T13 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channel for bringing Markarth's Namira cult to justice. Machine-verified; runtime evidence remains open.

options.name: Siege at Icemoth (T13 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channels for ending the necromancer's undead army and uncovering the Font of Memory. Machine-verified; runtime evidence remains open.

options.name: Hunt for the Spectre (T13 experimental)

options.name: Calling the Watchmaker (T13 experimental)

options.name: The Gift of Saturalia (T13 experimental)

options.name: Thogra (T14 experimental)
options.description: Data-only blood-oath, betrayal, and two marriage-route channels. The objective-derived Largashbur marriage must be traversed organically.

options.name: Song of the Green - Auri (T14 experimental)

options.name: M'rissi's Tails of Troubles (T14 experimental)

options.name: Xelzaz (T14 experimental)

options.name: Moonpath to Elsweyr (T14 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channels for the Tenmar journey, Thalmor rebellion, saved/released plague branches, and completed rebel base.

options.name: Paarthurnax - Quest Expansion (T15 experimental)

options.name: Forsworn Conspiracy - Quest Expansion (T15 experimental)

options.name: Thieves Guild Alternative Endings (T16 experimental)
options.description: Self-contained data channel plus generic quest-stage adapter that separates TG09's three endings without replacing Devotion scripts. Vanilla return remains stage 200; freeing the Nightingales and keeping the Skeleton Key route to synthetic stages 201/202 and suppress false Nocturnal commitment.

options.name: Save the Icerunner (T16 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channels for stopping, persuading, joining, betraying, or lawfully exposing Jaree-Ra's Icerunner wrecking plot.

options.description: Data-only channels for the Trial of Trinimac, ending the Eye of Camlorn's curse, and bringing peace to a Snow Elf ghost. Composite Ezra branches and linear relic fetches are deliberately excluded.

options.name: Beyond Skyrim - Bruma (T17 experimental)
options.description: Data-only channels for eight direct Bruma resolutions: smuggling, treacherous murder or generous song restoration, freeing Bjarni, and recovering stolen antiquities.
